narrative.overview: One complete generated daily-life scene leads the Hero; native editable copy establishes positioning, maximum amount and next entry. The untouched original HOME explains the actual product below. Full-site visual redesign preserves approved content, framework and interactions. Generated scene is illustrative, not customer/company evidence; concepts are not deployable assets.
keyCharacteristics: Contextual lifestyle composition with separate mobile copy/photo arrangement.
Original full HOME product introduction and subordinate repayment explanation.
Open four-step typography, distinct company facts, split FAQ, one conversion and separate safety.
Coordinated header, controls, support reading surfaces and ink footer.

rules.name: Chapter Rhythm
rules.body: Let the photographic Hero lead, then use white product/process/help, neutral repayment/company, cyan final conversion and ink footer. No repeated oversized campaign panels.

rules.name: Thai Integrity
rules.body: Preserve reviewed Thai, natural wrapping and zero Thai letter spacing. Numeral tracking is separate.

rules.name: Image Integrity
rules.body: Untouched complete App PNGs supply product evidence. Generated life scene is illustrative context only; concepts, fake interfaces and unselected hardware are not production assets.

dos: Use original Logo and complete real App screenshots.
Use one coherent life scene without presenting fictional people as customers or employees.
Preserve exact approved copy, pending download/legal states and keyboard access.
Verify1440/360/375/390 actual renders and report current-round results separately.
donts: Do not reintroduce rejected still-life props, unselected hardware frames, fake App interfaces or approval evidence.
Do not crop App screens into decorative halves or repaint their content.
Do not invent financial claims, store links, paymentQR, eligibility, official channels or licenses.
Do not treat generated concepts, source metadata or previous-round QA as current acceptance results.
